title: Rate limits for Spark Ads Recommendation API
content_data:
Global rate limits are applicable to Spark Ads Recommendation API endpoints. 

To learn about the global rate limits for a developer application, refer to [Rate limits - Global rate limits](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740029171730433#item-link-Global%20rate%20limits).
seo_title: Rate limits for Spark Ads Recommendation API
seo_description: Learn more about the rate limits for Spark Ads Recommendation API endpoints per developer app. This helps prevent rate limit errors.
